meta.title: Decision Layer
meta.description: A structured decision layer for the DeepSeek Harness agent loop: a danger-call gate, output self-check, and loop guard backed by a pluggable adjudication model.

en.analysisAccuracyEmpty: No decisions rated yet. Rate rows below as correct / wrong / unsure and a summary appears here.
en.analysisIntro: A read-only aggregate and manual annotation over this session’s persisted decision log. It changes no agent behavior.
en.analysisLogNote: Ratings here share one source with the intervention panel: a rating on either surface writes to the same log, keyed by decision id, latest wins.
en.analysisLogTruncated: No decision rows to show for this session.
en.analysisTrendNote: Replays this session’s self-check scores in time order under the current thresholds to count how often the alarm would fire — a calibration aid, not a live signal.
en.annotateFailed: Could not save the rating. Please retry.
en.checkNoiseHint: The model had almost no confidence in this score (near-zero confidence). This low score does not count toward the quality trend and triggers no re-prompt — treat it as noise. What matters is several consecutive high-confidence low scores.
en.completeHint: At turn end, each explicit deliverable condition the user listed (numbered / bulleted / multi-command) is judged satisfied / unsatisfied / insufficient evidence, with tool evidence as the source of truth — a reply claiming completion is not evidence. Off: results are only logged, the conversation is not interrupted. On: when a condition is confidently judged unsatisfied, one prompt is appended on your behalf asking the AI to review and finish it; insufficient evidence never triggers a re-prompt, and at most one per turn.
en.completeSteer: Auto re-prompt on an unmet condition
en.destination: Decisions send the necessary evaluation context to this backend:
en.empty: No automatic decisions yet. Manual verdicts are not counted here.
en.enabled: Enable automatic interventions in this session
en.featureCheckHint: When off, the final reply is no longer scored at the end of a turn.
en.featureCompleteHint: When off, the explicit deliverable conditions the user listed are no longer checked at turn end.
en.featureGateHint: When off, destructive tool calls are no longer evaluated for interception and are only bound by the host permission rules.
en.featureNarrowHint: When off, tool relevance is no longer evaluated at the start of a turn. The loop guard is a deterministic local safeguard that is always on and not covered by this switch.
en.gatePassThrough: no intervention (proceeded on its original path)
en.httpWarning: This address uses unencrypted HTTP. Your API key and evaluation context will be sent in plaintext to this address.
en.keyHintEmpty: No key saved yet. Leave blank to use an environment credential, or enter one to save it locally.
en.keyHintSaved: A key is saved. Leave blank and save to keep it; enter a new value and save to overwrite it.
en.logCheckHint: After each turn, the AI’s final reply for that turn is sent to the adjudication model, which grades its quality on three levels (severe omission/contradiction → minor gaps → complete and accurate) as a 0–2 score, to catch omissions or contradictions.
en.logEmpty: No decisions recorded for this session yet.
en.logNarrowHint: At the start of each turn, the current task and each available tool are sent to the adjudication model (a noul per tool) to judge relevance, dropping tools clearly not needed. It only intersects the host-allowed set and never expands it; observe merely logs the suggestion, enforced actually restricts the tools for this turn.
en.logScoreHint: The score is a probability-weighted mean across the levels, so it can be fractional (e.g. 1.4); the top score is the highest level number, 2.
en.narrowHint: At the start of each turn, the adjudication model judges how relevant each optional tool is to the task and drops the ones not needed; core tools (read, write, edit, shell, search, todos) are always kept and never judged. Enforced by default: only the relevant tools are kept for this turn, intersected with the host-allowed set and never expanded. Turn on Observe only to just log the tools that could be dropped, without changing the tool set. Three safeguards: core tools always kept; more than 20 optional tools falls back to observe only; fewer than 5 tools remaining is treated as untrustworthy and skipped.
en.narrowKeepHint: Tools whose names start with any of these prefixes are always kept and never judged for relevance — good for resident, on-demand tools like memory/retrieval (defaults to mcp__openviking and team_task_). Separate prefixes with commas or newlines; leave empty to keep nothing extra.
en.narrowMaxHint: When more than this many optional tools are judged in one turn (default 20), narrowing downgrades to observe only instead of actually restricting, so a large surface is never mass-pruned. Range 1–200; a higher value leans toward actually narrowing. Core tools and keep-prefix matches do not count.
en.narrowThresholdHint: A tool is dropped only when its relevance probability is below this value (default 0.3). A probability near 0.5 means the model is unsure, not "moderately relevant", so keeping is safer there; lower is more conservative (drops fewer), higher is more aggressive. Range 0–1.
en.removeKeyConfirm: Delete the locally saved API key? It will fall back to the environment credential.
en.removeKeyHint: Permanently deletes the key this plugin stored locally, then falls back to the environment credential; credentials configured elsewhere are untouched.
en.selfCheckHint: Each turn ends by scoring the final reply (0–2, a probability-weighted mean across the levels, so it can be fractional like 1.4). Off: low scores are only logged, the conversation is not interrupted. On: when the score is low (≤1) and the model is confident enough, one prompt is appended on your behalf asking the AI to review for gaps or contradictions and finish the work; low-confidence scores are only logged, never interrupt, and at most one prompt per turn.
en.selfCheckSteer: Auto re-prompt on a low score
en.summary: A danger-call gate, output self-check, and loop guard driven by a pluggable adjudication model.
en.title: Decision layer
en.trendSevereHint: Output quality has stayed low this session (high confidence). Consider adjusting the prompt, switching models, or starting a new session.
en.trendWarnHint: Output quality has been low for a few consecutive turns this session (high confidence). It may be rising task difficulty or model drift — consider adjusting the prompt or switching models.
